name: Macro Recorder Lite
headline: RECORD -> DO IT -> REPLAY
description: Record short keyboard macros by performing them once. Macro Recorder Lite captures key down/up events, shortcuts, key combinations and timing on Windows, then replays them from Stream Deck without scripting. New recordings automatically fill an empty Play key, and you can inspect the recorded steps and adjust delays. Lite is limited to 10 seconds and 50 keyboard events per macro. Macro Recorder Pro adds mouse recording, longer macros, playback speed, repeat modes, a reusable Macro Library, full editing and import/export.
release_notes:
- Record keyboard shortcuts, combinations and timing for up to 10 seconds / 50 events.
- New recordings automatically fill an empty Play key; each Play key stores its own local macro.
- Inspect recorded keyboard steps and adjust per-step delays without writing macro syntax.
- Includes focused Record / Play / Stop / Find / Save / Next x3 starter profiles for Stream Deck, Mini, XL, Plus and Neo.
- Uses the canonical PackRat Property Inspector and red Record / green Play / white Stop key visuals.
tagline: Record short keyboard workflows once. Replay them from Stream Deck.
privacy: Macro contents are never uploaded to PackRat. Lite stores each assigned keyboard macro in that local Stream Deck Play action's settings. Exporting or sharing a Stream Deck profile can include those action settings.
pro_url_policy: Optional post-launch upgrade link. Populate only after the direct Macro Recorder Pro Marketplace product URL is verified.
limitations: Playback uses the Windows SendInput API and may be blocked when the target app runs at a higher Administrator integrity level than Stream Deck.
Windows secure desktop, including UAC secure prompts, is outside normal recording and playback.
